description: This file defines the AdminController class for OrchardCore.Flows module, handling flow content editing in the admin interface, including building editors and retrieving content types.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Controller for managing flow content in the admin interface, including building editors and retrieving content types.

methods.name: BuildEditor
methods.description: Creates a content card shape for editing flow content, configuring shape properties based on flow metadata and content types.

methods.name: GetContainedContentTypesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves content type definitions that are marked as widgets, based on flow part settings.

methods.name: GetDefaultAlignment
methods.description: Returns the default flow alignment, defaulting to Justify if not specified.
